notes.title: Zombie Busters service termination notice
notes.content:
Zombie Busters service termination notice

Hello,
This is the Zombie Busters development team.

We would like to thank the users who have enjoyed Zombie Busters.

After much deliberation, we have decided to terminate the service of Zombie Busters.
Once again, we are very sorry to deliver this news to users who loved and enjoyed Zombie Busters, and we would like to express my sincere gratitude to users who have supported and encouraged Zombie Busters.

Zombie Busters will be on the server for about 90 days until December 27th.

Please see below for details on service termination.
- Game service end: December 27, 2021 (Mon) 11:00 AM
